findings.title: LimitRange rejects the pods
findings.cause: Deployment kd-limitrange-max-memory/web cannot create pods: a LimitRange in kd-limitrange-max-memory rejects them (maximum memory usage per Container is 64Mi, but limit is 128Mi)

evidence.detail: (combined from similar events): Error creating: pods "web-6bc7c8f797-sv2dh" is forbidden: maximum memory usage per Container is 64Mi, but limit is 128Mi

findings.fix: Set the containers' requests and limits inside the LimitRange's minimum and maximum, or change the LimitRange.
